_comment: Faerie-canonical Breadcrumbs plugin configuration. Drop this into .obsidian/plugins/breadcrumbs/data.json (merge, don't replace). Locks the hierarchy to N/S/E/W bearings + a comprehensive set of IMPLIED relations so you never have to author both sides of any link manually. If A says N: B, Breadcrumbs auto-infers B has S: A. If two notes share N: C, Breadcrumbs auto-infers they have E: each-other. Etc. The implied rules below cover every common relationship so a single one-sided declaration paints the whole graph.

_field_semantics.N: unblock / prerequisite / upstream — what this depends on or what depends on me getting cleared
_field_semantics.S: ship / deliverable / downstream — what I deliver into or what delivers into me
_field_semantics.E: parallel / sister / sibling — same DAG level, same charter or substrate
_field_semantics.W: baseline / re-seat / anchor — what I'm re-validating against

userHierImpliedRelations._rule: Inverse: if A.N = B, then B.S = A. (A is unblocked-by B means B ships-to A.)
Inverse: if A.S = B, then B.N = A.
Inverse: if A.W = B (anchor/baseline), then B has A as a re-seater (no formal counter — keep one-way).
userHierImpliedRelations._note_off: W is one-directional — anchors don't need outbound links to every re-seater.

userHierImpliedRelations._rule: Symmetric: if A.E = B, then B.E = A. (E-parallel is mutual.)
Co-siblings: if A.N = X and B.N = X, then A.E = B and B.E = A. (Two notes sharing an unblocker are parallel siblings.)
Cousin via shared S: if A.S = X and B.S = X, A and B are co-deliverers, infer A.E = B.
userHierImpliedRelations._note: Caution: can over-fire. Disable if mission-cluster halos look noisy.

userHierImpliedRelations._rule: Aunt/Uncle: parent's-sibling. If A.N = P and P.E = Q, then Q is A's aunt — show as related-of-N.
Grandparent: A.N = P, P.N = G, then A's grandparent is G — surfaces in trail navigation.
Same-mission cluster: any two notes sharing cluster_prefix get inferred E.
userHierImpliedRelations._note: Custom rule — Breadcrumbs may not natively support this; if not, drop and use a Dataview-based fallback in 02-Missions-Emergent.md.

userHierImpliedRelations._rule: Same charter_ref implies parallel. Two manifests under one charter are siblings.
Charter is upstream of all its manifests. Any note with charter_ref = X has implied N = X.
userHierImpliedRelations._note: Crucial — keeps the cornerstone Charter→Manifest N→S relation alive even when only charter_ref is declared.

_implied_relations_rationale:
The point of these rules is to AUTHOR ONLY THE STRONGEST DIRECTION OF EACH RELATIONSHIP, then let Breadcrumbs infer the rest. Examples:

  - A charter declares its deliverables_address_prefix; manifests get N->charter inferred via charter_ref rule.
  - A manifest declares N: [other unblockers]; the other notes auto-show this manifest in their S panel.
  - Two manifests under same charter auto-show as E to each other.
  - An anchor declares its evidence manifests via S; they don't have to declare W back at the anchor.

This halves the authoring burden and prevents the classic frontmatter-out-of-sync bug.
_warning: Breadcrumbs custom implied-relations evolve across plugin versions. If a rule key here doesn't match the current plugin schema, Breadcrumbs may ignore it silently. Verify after install via the Breadcrumbs Trail Side View — if expected implied links don't show up, check the plugin's settings UI for the actual schema and adjust here.
